recovered_fields.amazon.observed_at: Unix timestamp in each product link's qid parameter
recovered_fields.brand: Amazon, and Flipkart rows without a brand: first word of the title (brand_source=title_first_word)
recovered_fields.variant: Flipkart specification fields (model ID, style code, colour, pattern...) or a model code in the description; Amazon bracketed title suffix
recovered_fields.flipkart.rating_count: 0 where the source says 'No rating available'; otherwise unknown
recovered_fields.category_group: source category root mapped to 16 groups; rows whose category field holds the product title are classified by title keywords (category_source)

policy: Keep platforms distinct; no currency conversion; recovered fields are derived from source text, never generated; quarantine all conflicting price IDs; retain first source row for other duplicate IDs. Synthetic data lives in datasets/final with provenance='synthetic'.
